descriptionChirho: A voluntary sacrificial offering given freely to God, not required by law or vow, in all its inflected forms (singular, plural, construct, with possessive suffixes and prepositions indicating purpose or manner of offering).
The abstract quality of willingness or voluntariness, used adverbially to describe acting of one's own free will without compulsion.
Liberal giving or abundance, emphasizing the generous and plentiful character of what is offered rather than the cultic offering itself.
